_comment: TEMPLATE - no real keys, no real paths. Safe to commit.
Your real file is models.json, next to bonsai_web.py. That one is
git-ignored. Copy this over it with:
copy models.example.json models.json      (Windows)
cp models.example.json models.json        (Linux)
models.json is OPTIONAL. If it is missing or unreadable, Bonsai builds its
own list: it finds every .gguf in this folder, pairs a vision projector to
a text model when the filenames match, and drops any local entry whose
file is not actually present. You only need this file to pre-configure
context sizes, ports, sampling defaults, or API models.
Fields, all optional except id and type:
id        unique name, used everywhere internally
label     what the dropdown shows
type      'local' (llama.cpp on this PC) or 'api' (a hosted endpoint)
path      local only - absolute path to the .gguf
mmproj    local only - absolute path to the vision projector
port      local only - llama-server port (default 8080)
ctx       context window to assume
cfg       per-model sampling overrides (ctx/temp/top_p/top_k/ngl)
wire      'chat' for /v1/chat/completions, 'responses' for /v1/responses
omit      tool names this model must not be offered
For an API model, api_key is the NAME of an entry in 'API KEYS.txt', not
the key itself. Never put a live key in this file.
Delete any entry you do not want. This is yours to edit.
